# Project: Rube Goldberg Builder

2D browser physics puzzle game. Read docs/PRD.md and docs/MVP.md before
making changes.

## Stack

- Vanilla JavaScript (ES modules), HTML canvas, Matter.js (CDN)
- No frameworks and no new dependencies without asking

## Rules

- Work on one MVP milestone at a time and wait for my confirmation
- Keep level data (JSON) separate from Matter.js bodies
- Reset rebuilds bodies from JSON; never clone or rewind live bodies
- Use a fixed physics timestep
- Small functions, with comments explaining physics choices
- After writing code, explain what it does and where it could break

For v1.1 work, also read docs/V1_1_PLAN.md and do one phase at a time.
